name: opinion
description: OPINION: the dark social map. Speak only where you stand.

scripts.typecheck: cd web && npx tsc -b && cd ../worker && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.db:create: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 create opinion-db
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm --prefix worker run deploy
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build:demo && cd worker && npx wrangler pages deploy ../web/dist --project-name opinion-demo --branch main
